raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Fixes #64014: propagate `--enable-per-request-metrics` to `/v1/messages` and preserve metrics when converting OpenAI responses to Anthropic responses.

## Claims
- Non-streaming messages expose the existing `metrics` object alongside `usage`.
- Streaming messages expose metrics only on the final usage-bearing `message_delta`.
- Disabled metrics remain omitted. Documents the response shape and adds converter and real-server regression coverage.

## Validation
- Converter suite: `python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/entrypoints/anthropic tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py -q` (using the existing uv-managed `.venv/bin/python`). 126 passed.
- Before fix, the four new converter cases produced 3 failures and 1 pass: full responses lacked a metrics attribute and streaming dropped enabled metrics.
- Ruff check, Ruff format check, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Real-server regression attempted: `python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_messages.py -k per_request_metrics -q`. Both cases stop at device initialization (`Failed to infer device type`) on this macOS host. No model-serving evaluation or GPU benchmark is claimed; GPU CI validation is still required.
- The converter command excludes the parent GPU cleanup fixture because local PyTorch segfaults in `torch.accelerator.memory.empty_host_cache` during teardown. No repository fixtures were changed.
- Existing Buildkite Entrypoints Integration (API Server Generate) selects the Anthropic test directory and depends on `vllm/`.

## Details
The Anthropic handler omitted the flag when constructing its chat-serving parent, and both response converters dropped the parent's metrics. Reuse the shared `PerRequestMetrics` type and computation; no engine, scheduler, or model code changes.

The issue title and my initial claim comment refer to `usage.metrics`. This change follows the existing documented API contract: `metrics` is a top-level sibling of `usage`, including on the final Anthropic streaming event. Streaming usage is already forced by the Anthropic request conversion.

Duplicate checks: reviewed #64014 and its comments, searched open PR bodies for 64014 and open PRs for Anthropic metrics; no overlapping fix found at submission time. AI assistance was used. Human review is pending; the author requested publication now and will review after waking up.

---

- [x] **Design Fit:** Reuses shared metrics without changing core generation.

@@ -132,6 +132,16 @@ model-generation turns, such as built-in tool-call workflows, because the
 response retains timing data for only one generation turn while token usage is
 accumulated across all turns.
 
+## Anthropic Messages API
+
+Per-request metrics are available on `/v1/messages` with
+`--enable-per-request-metrics`. Non-streaming responses include the common
+`metrics` object at the top level, alongside `usage`. Streaming responses include
+it at the top level of the final `message_delta` event carrying `usage`; earlier
+events do not include metrics. Anthropic streams always include this usage event,
+so no additional client-side stream options are needed. Metrics are omitted when
+the flag is disabled.
+
 ## Relationship to Prometheus Metrics
 
 The `metrics` response field provides per-request values for a single request.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", [False, True])
+def test_full_response_preserves_metrics(enabled):
+    metrics = PerRequestMetrics(time_to_first_token_ms=12.5) if enabled else None
+    response = ChatCompletionResponse(
+        id="chatcmpl-metrics",
+        model="test-model",

+            ChatCompletionResponseChoice(
+                index=0,
+                message=ChatMessage(role="assistant", content="hello"),
+                finish_reason="stop",
+            )

+        usage=UsageInfo(prompt_tokens=5, completion_tokens=1, total_tokens=6),
+        metrics=metrics,
+    )
+    result = AnthropicServingMessages.messages_full_converter(None, response)
+    payload = result.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
+    assert result.metrics == metrics
+    assert ("metrics" in payload) == enabled
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", [False, True])
+async def test_stream_metrics_only_on_final_message_delta(enabled):
+    metrics = PerRequestMetrics(time_to_first_token_ms=12.5) if enabled else None
+
+    async def source():
+        yield _make_stream_chunk()
+        yield _make_stream_chunk(delta=DeltaMessage(content="hello"))
+        yield _make_stream_chunk(finish_reason="stop")
+        yield ChatCompletionStreamResponse(
+            id="chatcmpl-metrics",
+            model="test-model",
+            choices=[],
+            usage=UsageInfo(prompt_tokens=5, completion_tokens=1, total_tokens=6),
+            metrics=metrics,
+        )
+
+    events = _parse_sse_events(
+        [
+            event
+            async for event in AnthropicServingMessages.message_stream_converter(
+                None, source()
+            )
+        ]
+    )
+    final = [data for name, data in events if name == "message_delta"]
+    assert len(final) == 1
+    assert ("metrics" in final[0]) == enabled
+    if enabled:
+        assert final[0]["metrics"] == metrics.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+    assert all(
+        "metrics" not in data for name, data in events if name != "message_delta"
+    )

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+async def test_per_request_metrics(client: anthropic.AsyncAnthropic, stream: bool):
+    """The metrics flag reaches the Anthropic endpoint and survives conversion."""
+    response = await client.messages.create(
+        model="claude-3-7-sonnet-latest",
+        max_tokens=8,
+        temperature=0,
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Count from one to ten."}],
+        stream=stream,
+    )
+    if stream:
+        metrics_events = []
+        async for event in response:
+            metrics = event.model_extra.get("metrics")
+            if metrics is not None:
+                assert event.type == "message_delta"
+                assert event.usage.output_tokens > 0
+                metrics_events.append(metrics)
+        assert len(metrics_events) == 1
+        metrics = metrics_events[0]
+    else:
+        assert response.usage.output_tokens > 0
+        metrics = response.model_extra.get("metrics")
+    assert metrics is not None
+    assert metrics["time_to_first_token_ms"] >= 0
+    assert metrics["generation_time_ms"] >= 0
+    assert metrics["queue_time_ms"] >= 0
+    assert metrics["tokens_per_second"] > 0
